mapper.insert: insert into gamegroupmemberdetail(USERUNIQUE, USERID, STUDENTNO, STUDENTNAME, TITLE, CONTRIBUTION, GROUPNAME) values (#{userUnique}, #{userId}, #{studentNo}, #{studentName}, #{title}, #{contribution}, #{groupName});
mapper.update: update gamegroupmemberdetail SET CONFIRM = 1 where gamegroupmemberdetail.GROUPNAME =#{groupName}

update gamegroupmemberdetail
USERUNIQUE = #{memberDetail.userUnique,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
USERID=#{memberDetail.userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
STUDENTNO=#{memberDetail.studentNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
STUDENTNAME= #{memberDetail.studentName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
TITLE=#{memberDetail.title,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
CONTRIBUTION = #{memberDetail.contribution,jdbcType=FLOAT},
CONFIRM = #{memberDetail.confirm,jdbcType=INTEGER},
GRADE = #{memberDetail.grade,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
GROUPNAME= #{memberDetail.groupName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
where USERUNIQUE = #{memberDetail.userUnique} AND STUDENTNO= #{studentNo}
mapper.select: SELECT USERUNIQUE, USERID, STUDENTNO, STUDENTNAME, TITLE, CONTRIBUTION, CONFIRM, GRADE, GROUPNAME, SCORE from gamegroupmemberdetail where USERUNIQUE = #{userUnique};
select USERUNIQUE,USERID,STUDENTNO,STUDENTNAME,TITLE,CONTRIBUTION,CONFIRM,GRADE,GROUPNAME FROM gamegroupmemberdetail where USERUNIQUE = #{userUnique} and STUDENTNO = #{studentNo};
